explanation: Two equal circles start almost touching above the floor under strong gravity with fully elastic restitution (e=1). Gravity accelerates them into floor/body contact within 2-3 steps; sequential impulse resolution with e=1 on near-simultaneous floor-plus-body contacts injects kinetic energy (bodies rebound faster than they impacted, e.g. body 1 leaves at vy~4.23). With zero controller work, total mechanical energy grows from ~30.3J to ~43.05J, exceeding the 10%+5J bound. Setting e=0 removes the amplification and energy falls.
